sloka: प्रवृद्ध निद्रे शयिते त्वयि राक्षस पांसने ।भविष्यन्ति अशरण्यानाम् शरण्या दण्डका इमे ॥३-३०-८॥
transliteration: pravṛddha nidre śayite tvayi rākṣasa pāṁsane ।bhaviṣyanti aśaraṇyānām śaraṇyā daṇḍakā ime ॥3-30-8॥

translations.english: When you, O vile demon, will go into eternal sleep the Dandaka grounds will provide shelter to those who deserve it here.
